title: Foulkes plethysm
statement: For all positive integers a≤b, the symmetric function h_b[h_a]−h_a[h_b] is Schur-positive.

counterexample.description: For \(a\le b\), a partition \(\lambda\vdash ab\) with a negative Schur coefficient in \(h_b[h_a]-h_a[h_b]\). Exact character arithmetic directly verifies the coefficient.
